title: [CQ-M06b1] Composition seams A-C: stale revision, check and recipe
description:
Objective: deliver the three composition seams of [CQ-M06b] (task-4359d60bbc9b4d1b83353edfbdaa518a) whose producers have all landed, so this work does not wait on CQ-M05:
- stale revision (F×C×V);
- check (V×C×M);
- recipe (C×F×M).

This is a SPIDR prerequisite slice carved out of CQ-M06b, at the governor's 2026-10-31 request (msg-5271e9cc), to put idle coders on work that is independent today. CQ-M06b keeps the isolation seam (R×M×V×I), which needs CQ-M05's rollout controls, and re-verifies the whole file.

Why it can start now. Every producer it crosses is DONE:
- F12 (task-72184c65);
- C07-C11 (C11 task-4e0264fc);
- V01-V06, V12a and V12b (V12 itself is docs, regression and review only, with no code);
- M01's execution profiles: 'legacy' and 'observe' exist today.
CQ-M05 changes only the settings write path (state/profileRollout.ts) and strict-attempt readiness in complete_task. Its own plan tests that observe cannot authorize a recipe bypass or a verified completion. Neither change alters these seams' legacy or observe outcomes.

Deliverable: packages/moe-daemon/src/__e2e__/workstreamComposition.e2e.test.ts, a new file. Tests only, using real tools and stores and temp Git repos, with the shared fixture and one describe per seam, as CQ-M06b's approved plan rev 1 specifies for seams A, B and C.
- Fixture:
  - ToolTestHarness and a real temp Git repo; git() and commit() are copied from delivery/requiredChecks.delivery.test.ts, with GIT_* masked.
  - MOE_* seat env stubbed to ''.
  - bytes() over .moe/{tasks,attempts,candidates,checks,reviews,receipts}.
  - refused(call, codeName) asserts the codeName and an unchanged bytes().
  - Profiles are set only through h.state.updateSettings. The strict cutover is only F12's in-memory hand edit.
  - Every expectation is exact.
- Seam A, stale revision (F×C×V). A requirement edit after approval advances planRevision.
  - Strict start_step and complete_task are refused PLAN_REVISION_NOT_APPROVED.
  - qa_approve naming the old candidate is refused.
  - The old check run no longer counts: assert its exact missingEvidence token.
  - Plan reuse never resumes the row, and readRecipeInstance reads null.
  - Legacy control: the compatibility path is kept.
- Seam B, check (V×C×M). deliveryPolicy 'local-branch', table over ['legacy','observe']. Each of these is refused at qa_approve with its exact codeName or token, and no review is written:
  - no check run;
  - each non-passing outcome;
  - a self-labelled 'runner-observed' run sent without the runner channel;
  - a candidate that changes a protected config (protected-check-changed:<path>);
  - a recipe candidate that edits .moe/recipes.json, inside the temp repo only.
  Control: a passing authenticated run approves under both profiles.
- Seam C, recipe (C×F×M). Table over ['legacy','observe'], approvalMode CONTROL:
  - ineligible and mismatched instantiations fall back to ordinary planning and leave the row byte-identical;
  - an eligible instantiation lands AWAITING_APPROVAL with no approvedPlanRevision;
  - submit_plan as 'moe-recipe' without the internal channel is refused NOT_ALLOWED;
  - approving with a stale expectedPlanRevision is refused PLAN_REVISION_MISMATCH.
  Outcomes are identical across the two profiles.

Not in scope:
- The isolation seam D, which stays on CQ-M06b.
- New production behavior. A defect fix over about 30 lines, or any contract change, goes to its owning task through moe.report_blocked.
- IDE rendering, VM provisioning and docs.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test
definitionOfDone: packages/moe-daemon/src/__e2e__/workstreamComposition.e2e.test.ts holds the shared fixture and one describe each for the stale-revision (F×C×V), check (V×C×M) and recipe (C×F×M) seams in this description, each driven through real tools with exact codeName assertions. It has no isolation seam.
Every refusal case also proves nothing was written: task, attempt, candidate, check, review and receipt bytes are unchanged.

The check and recipe seams run under both legacy and observe and give identical outcomes, ids and timestamps aside. No gate is mocked, no test-only certification is used, and verified-local is never made ready.
Legacy-profile control rows keep their existing compatibility outcomes in the same scenarios.

Each seam is proven to bite by at least one scratch-copy mutant of the production code it crosses, for example: dropping the 'moe-recipe' identity check in submit_plan; making evaluateDeliveryEvidence ignore the check outcome; accepting a self-labelled runner-observed run; skipping the approval-revision CAS in approveTask; skipping the protected-path drift check. The completion summary lists each mutant and the case it turns red.

Tests only: a defect fix over about 30 lines, or any contract change, goes to its owning task through moe.report_blocked.
